name: PTU Combat Move Outcome Handlers

drain_half.effect: controlled user gains floor(target damage / 2) HP
drain_half.rounding: PTU Core general decimal rule: round down

inputs: same abstract target when a chain exists
fury_cutter.target_identity: not persisted; same-target continuity is user-confirmed

fell_stinger.input: did this Move knock out the target?
fell_stinger.effect: on confirmed successful knockout, raise controlled user Attack by 2 Combat Stages, capped by normal CS bounds

close_combat.effect: controlled user Defense -1 CS and Special Defense -1 CS
close_combat.source_semantics: self stage change from the supplied Move effect

leaf_storm.input: did the Move actually deal damage?
leaf_storm.effect: on confirmed damage, controlled user Special Attack -2 CS

petal_dance.input: did the Move actually deal damage?
petal_dance.effect: on confirmed damage, controlled user becomes Enraged and Confused
petal_dance.tracking: combat-session condition flags; no enemy state

charge_beam.effect: controlled user Special Attack +1 CS on 7+

non_goals: No enemy/NPC entity or HP ledger.
No generated d20 or damage dice.
No generic prose interpreter for Move effects.
